title: Constructing an overlay image array
description: You can follow array slices that define a card's colored regions.
source: draft: codex free model + edit: codex

steps.description: You create an image array with the supplied row and column counts and three color channels. The first full-array assignment selects the background color.
A rectangular slice receives the title-bar color. Row and column bounds locate it within the overlay's own coordinates.

steps.question: How many text-like strips does this range create?
steps.answer: Four strips, beginning at the rows selected by the range.

steps.description: You fill each strip with the same light color and display the overlay without axes. The supplied recording includes no text output or image to inspect.
